title: When the Compass Breaks
author: Paloma Ravensworth
blurb: Felix Eriksen, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
